description: Set a group membership as the default for a specific user in Zendesk. Use when you need to mark a user's group membership as the default, meaning tickets assigned directly to the agent will assume this membership's group. Requires both the user ID and the group membership ID. This action is useful for managing default routing preferences for agents in your Zendesk instance. Note that only one group membership can be the default at a time - setting a new default will automatically unset the previous default.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for setting a group membership as default for a user.

group_membership_id.description: The numeric ID of the group membership to set as default. This is the group membership ID, not a group ID.
group_membership_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the group membership you want to set as default for the specified user.
group_membership_id.title: Group Membership Id

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user. This is the user ID, not a membership ID.
user_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk user whose group membership you want to set as default.
user_id.title: User Id

inputSchema.title: SetGroupMembershipAsDefaultRequest

name: set_group_membership_as_default

created_at.description: The time the group membership was created in ISO 8601 format
created_at.title: Created At

default.description: If true, tickets assigned directly to the agent will assume this membership's group
default.title: Default
